narrative.title: Chapter 1 — The Signal
paras: Era can fly a ship. She can live on Earth. Earth will grow old and sick. The air and the water will turn bad. The people face a hard time.
One night, they see a light in the sky. It can be a message from Orion. People call it The Last Signal.
Era can read the message. She will learn of a new home far away. She can hope for the first time in a long time.

narrative.title: Chapter 2 — The Little Boat
paras: Era will meet a small group of people. They want to leave Earth too. Kai can lead the group. Vega can fly a ship like Era.
They have a small ship. People call it Aurora.
Aurora and a small boat will join the trip. They will travel to Orion. It will be a long trip across the dark space. Everyone can be afraid, but they stay together.

narrative.title: Chapter 3 — Leave Earth
paras: Aurora will leave Earth. Era can look back at the old world. She will feel sad, but she must go.
The group will move fast through the black sky. They travel for a long time.
They eat little food and drink little water. They share what they have. The group stay strong because they help each other.

narrative.title: Chapter 4 — Trouble in Space
paras: One night, a rock will hit Aurora. The small boat near Aurora will break.
Kai can tell everyone to stay safe. Era can use a skill to move Aurora away from the rock.
They lose one boat, but most of the people stay safe. They can feel the danger, but they will not stop. They must reach Orion.

narrative.title: Chapter 5 — Orion's Edge
paras: After a long trip they see the edge of Orion. It can be a place with bright star.
But a problem can appear. A big ship will block the way of the group. The people on it want the food and water of the group.
Kai can speak to the people. He will say they want no fight. They only want a new home. The other group can listen. They will decide to help, not fight.

narrative.title: Chapter 6 — The Last Signal
paras: Era can study the message again. The Last Signal can show a map. It can lead to a small world with water and green land. She will show the map to the group.
They follow the signal. The star can guide Aurora. Vega can fly the ship with care. Everyone can watch the sky for the new home.

narrative.title: Chapter 7 — A New World
paras: At last they reach the world. It will be beautiful. They see a blue sea and a wide sky. The people find clean air and soft ground.
They step out of the ship. They laugh and cry. They feel glad. The young run on the new ground. They know this can be the new home. Era can smile at the sky.

narrative.title: Chapter 8 — Build the Home
paras: The group will start to build. They make small house of wood and stone. They plant tree and start a garden. Vega and Kai can lead the work.
The people have a task. Some find water. Some cook food. Some watch the sky for danger. They can be a real community now.

narrative.title: Chapter 9 — Hard Days
paras: The first winter will be hard. The cold wind will blow. Food will be low. Some people want to leave.
Era can tell the people to stay. She will say they can be strong together. They share what little they have. The old and the young eat first.
Slowly, the day will grow warm again. The garden will grow.

narrative.title: Chapter 10 — New Friends
paras: The group from the big ship will return. They bring plant and tool.
Now the people from both group can be one. They learn each other's song and story. The young play together by the sea.
They forget the old fear. Peace will come to the new world.

narrative.title: Chapter 11 — The New Town
paras: Time will pass. The small world will become a town. New life will begin under the blue sky.
Era will not fly a ship now. She can be a teacher. She can teach the young to read the star. Kai and Vega can still lead the town.

narrative.title: Chapter 12 — The New Life
paras: Era can sit by the sea at night. She can think of Earth and the old day. She can be glad they follow The Last Signal.

The new world will be full of life and hope. She can send a message to the star. It will say: we can be alive, we can be free, and we remember. Maybe one day another signal will come. Until then, they will live with a strong heart and love.
